title: Scenario grader: Build does not check that each persona's permission set covers the reads and writes the card gives it
body:
epic:#33595#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qiby1cctpVpRbJzjccvY

Filed by eval#1 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzr7AespGQoymAnLtn.

Filing-gate category: ③ maintainer-directed child of #33595 (M1), quoted there; also ① grader gap, measured. `reach:` eval#1 round 1, 2026-11-14 (control cards, scratch, published 18.4.0, runner `d683e6f3`): Build 32/32 on `invoice_with_line_items` and 30/30 on `project_with_tasks`, yet the built apps refused `sales_rep` a line-item create and `contractor` a task create, update and delete that the cards' operations give them (403).

## Why it matters

The build is what a customer ships. A permission set that locks a role out of its own work is a broken app, and today only the Run half finds it, where it is charged to the agent (sibling child of #33595).

## Carrier

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-score.ts` (`expect` by name and shape) and `scenario-tags.ts` (`access-security.*` checks) read the built artifact; neither derives the persona grants the card implies.
- The runner's data contract already names each persona's permission set (`src/runner/prompts.ts`, `permissionSetName` in `src/runner/namespace.ts`).

## Done when

_Edited by epic:#33595#1: the refused arm of item 1 reads "the persona's set refuses the write", not "the verb is absent" (premise correction 6888060472: a 403 also comes from a field lock or a row policy, and `requisition_to_receipt` declares the same persona, object and verb both applied and refused)._

- From the card alone (questions a persona answers ⇒ read on that object; operations with outcome `applied` or `pending_confirmation` ⇒ the verb on that object; `refused PERMISSION_DENIED` ⇒ the persona's set refuses the write: the verb is not granted, or an unconditioned field entry the write names is not editable; not measured when only a row policy or a row-conditioned field entry could refuse it), the Build half adds one check per persona × object × verb against the built permission set, named `persona-grant:<persona>:<object>:<verb>`.
- The build prompt states nothing new: the grants already trace to the prompt through the data contract (`docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` "Build checks trace to the prompt"); if a grant does not, the card is fixed instead.
- Tests pin a grant missing, a grant present, and a grant the card refuses.

## Reader

The epic PM of #33595 dispatches it to `os-dev` (`domain:devx`).

Dedup: see #33595.
